title: Custom Jerseys with Logo (2026)
verdict: For custom jerseys with your logo in 2026, order from Wooter. The logo is sublimated into the jersey at any size and in any number of colors, and if your file is poor, the designers rebuild it for free.
Custom Ink prints a logo on stock jerseys and is quick. Boombah places logos in its builders. Champro and Nike Team add logos through their dealers.

cta.text: Send your logo for a free design

ranking.fit: Teams, companies and events that want their logo on a jersey made for them.
ranking.lacks: Three to four weeks after approval.

ranking.fit: Groups that want a design printed on stock jerseys, with a group order form for sizes.
ranking.lacks: The garment is stock, so cut, panels and fabric are fixed.

ranking.fit: Teams comfortable in an online builder that want to buy from the factory.
ranking.lacks: Baseball and softball get its deepest range. Other sports have fewer styles.

ranking.fit: Coaches whose school or league already has a Champro dealer.
ranking.lacks: No public prices, and the dealer places the order.

ranking.fit: Programs that want the Nike mark and can order months ahead.
ranking.lacks: 30, 60 or 90 days for build-to-order, through a dealer.

why: Most logo problems are file problems. A logo saved from a website is a few hundred pixels wide. Printed across a chest it turns to mush.
Send a vector file if one exists: AI, EPS, SVG or PDF. If it does not, send the largest image you have and ask for it to be redrawn.
Then decide where it goes. Left chest for a crest, center chest for a wordmark, sleeve or back for a sponsor.

criteria.name: Logo quality
criteria.text: A clean file, or a free redraw.

criteria.name: Proof
criteria.text: The logo shown at real size before printing.

faq.q: What logo file do I need?
faq.a: A vector file is best. A large PNG works, and Wooter's designers can rebuild a logo from it.

faq.q: We do not have a logo. Can you make one?
faq.a: Yes. Describe the team and the designers will draw a mark as part of the free design.

faq.q: Can we add a sponsor's logo?
faq.a: Yes. Get the sponsor's own file and check your league's rules on placement.

faq.q: Can I use a professional team's logo?
faq.a: No. Those are trademarks. Use your own.

faq.q: How many colors can the logo have?
faq.a: As many as you like on a sublimated jersey.
